Annual Report 2025

Gulf Water Services SAOG

Prepared by: Sara Al-Harthy, Chief Financial Officer
Published: 15 January 2026

Chairman's message

2025 was a year of steady growth. Revenue rose 12% to OMR 48.2 million, driven by new desalination contracts in Duqm and Salalah. Net profit reached OMR 6.1 million.

Operations

We commissioned two reverse-osmosis plants with a combined capacity of 60,000 m3 per day, and reduced non-revenue water from 18% to 14% across our distribution network.

Outlook

In 2026 we will expand smart metering to 40,000 households and invest in solar-powered pumping stations.

XR-200 Booster Pump — Installation Manual

Document MAN-XR200-EN, Revision 3, 2 November 2025

AquaFlow Engineering GmbH, Stuttgart, Germany

Safety

Disconnect mains power before opening the terminal box. Only qualified electricians may connect the pump.

Mounting

Install the pump horizontally on a level concrete base. Leave at least 300 mm clearance for ventilation. Use the four M10 anchor bolts supplied.

Commissioning

Prime the pump casing with water, open the discharge valve, and start the motor. Check the rotation direction matches the arrow on the casing.

How to Keep Houseplants Healthy in Summer

Hot weather dries out potting soil quickly. Water in the early morning so the roots can absorb moisture before the heat of the day, and check the soil with your finger before watering again.

Move plants away from windows that get strong afternoon sun, or hang a sheer curtain to filter the light. Group plants together to raise the humidity around their leaves.

Feed with a balanced liquid fertiliser every two weeks during the growing season, and wipe dust off large leaves so they can photosynthesise efficiently.
